integrity: Proof for all nonnegative integers n; finite reproducibility checks through n=7 do not substitute for the proof. Source first-public date is the earliest verified date of an explicitly relevant public preprint, not a journal or revision date.
scientific_limitations: The underlying star–triangle support structure and the maximum general-position number were previously known; the claimed contribution is the complete labeled cardinality distribution, recurrence and maximum-set multiplicity. Equivalence to an unindexed star-forest enumeration remains a literature risk. Independent scientific validation has not been performed.
title: Full general-position polynomial of triangular graphs by star–triangle components
